posts.text:
Sainz must start the Singapore sprint from the pit lane after Williams changed his suspension setup under parc fermé without FIA approval.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions

Red Bull replaced Hadjar's engine and turbo with previously used units before the Singapore sprint. The fuel collector assembly was also replaced, with the changes approved by the FIA.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions

Verstappen wins the Singapore sprint ahead of Hamilton and Leclerc. Antonelli finishes fourth, with Lawson, Bearman, Hülkenberg and Norris completing the points.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions

Norris and Piastri collide at Turn 5 on the Singapore sprint's final lap. Piastri retires and Norris finishes eighth.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions

Russell crashed out of the Singapore sprint lead after passing Verstappen at the start. Hadjar retired with power trouble, while Colapinto's Alpine shut down during the Safety Car period.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions

Verstappen takes Singapore GP pole by 0.054s from Leclerc. Hamilton and Antonelli share row two. Russell's engine penalty puts him on the back row with Hadjar.

Full provisional grid: https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions

No penalty for Norris or Piastri after their final-lap Singapore sprint collision. Stella calls the contact unacceptable and will speak to both privately.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions

More power trouble for Hadjar in Singapore: his engine switched off in Q1, and he failed to set a qualifying time. He also reported a gearbox failure and wants a fresh power unit for Sunday; no change is confirmed.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions

No penalty for Hülkenberg after impeding Sainz: inconsistent timing data had misled both teams. Hadjar has also been cleared to race in Singapore.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions?story=hulkenberg-singapore-qualifying-impeding-decision

Pirelli favours starting Singapore on soft tyres, then switching to mediums or hards. Low degradation could let drivers wait for a Safety Car; two stops are estimated to cost about ten seconds more.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions?story=pirelli-singapore-race-strategy

Verstappen questions Red Bull's second-gear approach after poor wet starts at Sepang and in the Singapore sprint. He would consider a different gear if today's start is wet, while hoping for a dry race.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions?story=verstappen-singapore-race-start-concern

Singapore's final grid: Alonso, Stroll and Hadjar start from the pit lane. Russell starts P19 despite a combined 60-place penalty. Verstappen and Leclerc share the front row.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions?story=singapore-starting-grid

The FIA admits its Singapore SQ1 error compromised fairness. A missed prompt left Overtake Mode off after the red flag; briefly enabling it for 27 seconds affected drivers unequally.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions?story=singapore-sq1-overtake-mode-error

Bortoleto, Colapinto and Stroll have retired from the Singapore Grand Prix. Audi suspects gearbox trouble for Bortoleto; Alpine suspects a driveline issue for Colapinto.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions?story=bortoleto-singapore-race-retirement

Verstappen wins his first Singapore Grand Prix on his 250th Grand Prix start, completing a weekend of two poles and two wins. Leclerc and Antonelli complete the podium; Norris and Piastri round out the top five.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions?story=singapore-grand-prix-verstappen-win

Hamilton slips from third to sixth as his soft tyres fade in Singapore. Piastri recovers from an extra stop for a puncture and passes him at Turn 16 on the final lap for fifth.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions?story=hamilton-singapore-race-tyre-fade

Antonelli has his first chance to seal the F1 title at Austin. He needs to win, with Russell and Hamilton’s finishes also deciding whether the championship is settled with five races left.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions?story=antonelli-singapore-title-chance

Hamilton apologised to Ferrari after his Singapore strategy left him sixth. He took responsibility for staying out under the VSC; Vasseur says the team called him in, but he missed the pit entry.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions?story=hamilton-singapore-race-tyre-fade

Verstappen won in Singapore despite struggling to speak to Red Bull. His engineer used coded messages, while early energy-deployment trouble gave Leclerc a chance to attack.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions?story=verstappen-singapore-race-radio-issue

Williams explains Albon's late Singapore retirement: he managed fuel and brake issues, then stopped to protect the car. He remains classified 18th.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions?story=albon-singapore-race-retirement

Leclerc wants more Ferrari upgrades after his first Grand Prix podium since Belgium. Norris says McLaren is now fourth fastest and also needs more upgrades after finishing 40 seconds behind Verstappen in Singapore.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions?story=norris-singapore-race-pace-assessment

Leclerc reported his Ferrari slowing without warning on lap 46 in Singapore. His engineer supplied a settings change two laps later, with no further recurrence reported.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions?story=leclerc-singapore-race-braking-issue

Mercedes says Antonelli's upgraded package was faster than the older specification by the end of Singapore. Finding the right setup window remains the task ahead of Austin.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions?story=mercedes-singapore-race-upgrade-assessment

Norris has apologised to McLaren and taken responsibility for his Singapore sprint move on Piastri. Stella says both drivers agree the clash was unacceptable and further talks will put the team's interests first.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions?story=mclaren-singapore-sprint-final-lap-collision

Red Bull has finished its major 2026 upgrade programme. Mekies says development now focuses on 2027, while the remaining races will help the team learn and improve how it uses the car.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions?story=red-bull-singapore-development-programme

Hülkenberg had his highest-scoring weekend of 2026 in Singapore: seventh in the sprint and eighth in the Grand Prix. A tow from Lawson helped him hold off Russell in the closing laps.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions?story=hulkenberg-singapore-best-weekend

Verstappen races his team's Mercedes-AMG GT3 at Portimão this Saturday, 17 October. The three-hour GT World Challenge finale starts at 17:00 local time, with free coverage on GT World YouTube.

https://gt-world-challenge-europe.com/news/3336/battle-royale-at-portimao-as-gt-world-concludes-2026-with-spectacular-finale

Rafael Câmara is set to replace Ocon at Haas alongside Bearman in 2027, RacingNews365 reports. The deal was agreed in Singapore, with a formal announcement expected this week.

https://racingnews365.com/haas-finalise-new-f1-driver-line-up-with-esteban-ocon-replacement-chosen

Tom Hart will be Verstappen's race engineer in Austin, Brazil and Las Vegas. Lambiase will still attend as Head of Racing, with no date announced for the permanent handover.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-united-states-grand-prix-predictions?story=verstappen-hart-race-engineer-austin

McLaren plans upgrades in stages to fight for podiums and test aerodynamic concepts for 2027. Stella says the final three races should give a clearer view of whether wins are possible.

https://www.motorsport.com/f1/news/mclaren-to-phase-upgrades-for-2026-fight-and-next-years-f1-development/10864787/

F1 has agreed a ten-year deal for an African Grand Prix in Rwanda from the early 2030s. A new circuit is planned in Bugesera, south of Kigali. The first race date is still to be announced. https://www.formula1.com/en/latest/article/everything-we-know-about-f1s-all-new-race-in-rwanda.3Mde3s9FqIOTbkzKs0Puwo

McLaren's remaining 2026 upgrades will add downforce, but Andrea Stella says the car's demanding handling needs more fundamental changes. He expects those to arrive with the 2027 car at the earliest. https://www.autosport.com/f1/news/why-mclaren-cannot-fix-its-f1-car-handling-until-2027/10864932/

Singapore's heat tested the brakes too. Antonelli raced without brake-temperature data after a sensor issue. Bottas had to lift and coast from lap two, despite Cadillac's cooling upgrades. https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions?story=antonelli-singapore-brake-temperature-data

Rwanda's proposed F1 circuit: 6km, 17 corners and 197 metres of elevation change across a lap. Wurz and Tilke are designing it around two hills and a lake. The full layout is still to come. https://www.formula1.com/en/latest/article/hills-a-lake-and-a-roller-coaster-inside-rwandas-plan-for-the-african-grand-prix.76LEZDItQYH362QElcHoY1

The FIA's 2027 rules tighten floor-support geometry: a 5mm limit on the rounded junction with bodywork, plus restrictions on where supports can meet it. The changes apply next season. https://www.fia.com/system/files/documents/fia_2027_f1_regulations_-_section_c_technical_-_iss_3_-_2026-10-01.pdf

Gasly says Alpine's tyres overheated within three laps in Singapore, leaving him struggling for traction. He finished 11th after starting seventh. https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-singapore-grand-prix-predictions?story=gasly-singapore-traction-tyre-overheating

Bottas says Cadillac is improving how it operates each weekend, even though the team is still chasing its first point. https://www.racefans.net/2026/10/14/spotlight-cadillac-already-has-better-facilities-than-mercedes-says-bottas/

Red Bull's recent engine gains have come through calibration, without a new specification. Ben Hodgkinson says there is more to come this season. https://www.the-race.com/formula-1/key-gains-red-bull-has-made-with-its-race-winning-f1-engine/

Verstappen and Hadjar will wear white race suits in Austin, with blue accents and vintage-style partner badges. https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-united-states-grand-prix-predictions?story=red-bull-austin-white-race-suits

Franco Colapinto has asked supporters to stop attacking rival drivers and people he works with online, saying those who think they are defending him are having the opposite effect. https://www.racefans.net/2026/10/15/colapinto-tells-his-supporters-to-stop-abusing-rival-drivers-they-dont-help-me/

Haas has signed Rafael Câmara on a multi-year deal for 2027, replacing Esteban Ocon. The 21-year-old leads this year's Formula 2 standings with two rounds left. Oliver Bearman's 2027 seat is still to be confirmed. https://www.skysports.com/f1/news/13599318/rafael-camara-haas-sign-brazilian-ferrari-academy-driver-to-team-for-2027-formula-1-season-on-multi-year-deal

Williams turns 50 in 2027. Plans include a London exhibition, the FW50 chassis name and a fan-chosen Silverstone livery. https://www.formula1.com/en/latest/article/williams-outline-plans-for-50th-anniversary-year-with-calendar-of-special-events.wxPd7X2kbw2bUHstwFeZB

Toto Wolff expects both Mercedes cars to run the latest upgrade in Austin, pending a final team decision. Only Antonelli used it in Singapore. Wolff says it has not yet delivered the performance Mercedes hoped for.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-united-states-grand-prix-predictions?story=mercedes-wolff-austin-upgrade-specification

Mercedes' free Austin fan hub runs from 22–25 October at 400 Congress Avenue. It includes a pit-stop challenge on a real F1 car, simulators and a 2026 show car. https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-united-states-grand-prix-predictions?story=mercedes-austin-free-fan-hub

Dino Beganovic becomes Ferrari's development and reserve driver for 2027, graduating from its driver academy. His role includes being ready to stand in for either race driver. https://dinoracing.se/en/dino-beganovic-signs-as-development-and-reserve-driver-for-scuderia-ferrari-hp/

Liam Lawson is taking to the stage in Austin. Liam Lawson & Friends headline VCARB Garage Sessions at Inn Cahoots on Thursday 22 October, ahead of the US Grand Prix. https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-united-states-grand-prix-predictions?story=lawson-austin-garage-sessions

Ferrari is expected to run a new floor in Austin, part of its fourth and final major upgrade of 2026. It aims for the same or more downforce with a less stiff set-up. Sidepod and bodywork changes may follow in Mexico. https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-united-states-grand-prix-predictions?story=ferrari-austin-new-floor

Verstappen's helmet for Austin puts a cowboy hat on the lion. He and Hadjar will also wear white, vintage-style race suits; an all-white Red Bull livery is not confirmed. https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-united-states-grand-prix-predictions?story=verstappen-texas-helmet-austin

Godzilla returns to Haas for Austin. The team will reveal its new livery on Monday 19 October, with matching race suits for Ocon and Bearman. https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-united-states-grand-prix-predictions?story=haas-austin-godzilla-livery

Mercedes found more downforce with its upgrade, but also a front-heavy balance that made the car harder to drive. The Austin focus is setup work to widen its operating window. https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-united-states-grand-prix-predictions?story=mercedes-austin-upgrade-balance

Kimi Antonelli can win the 2026 title in Austin. He leads Russell by 102 points and would need to win with Russell ninth or lower and Hamilton fifth or lower. https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-united-states-grand-prix-predictions?story=antonelli-title-clinch-austin

FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem says the final two races of 2026, in Qatar and Abu Dhabi, are going ahead as planned. He cannot predict what happens, and Imola remains ready as a replacement finale if needed. https://www.the-race.com/formula-1/fia-adamant-f1-qatar-abu-dhabi-gp-will-go-ahead/

Mercedes will run its latest update package on both cars in Austin. Only Antonelli used it in Singapore, while Russell ran the earlier specification.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-united-states-grand-prix-predictions?story=mercedes-wolff-austin-upgrade-specification

Austin forecast: no rain on Friday or Saturday, with track temperatures above 55C. Sunday has a 20% chance of rain and afternoon gusts of 35-40 km/h.

https://grandprixpicks.com/f1-2026-united-states-grand-prix-predictions?story=austin-weather-forecast-dry-friday-saturday
